description: NACA 0012 Re=2000 DNS from finite-amplitude Re=2000 wake restart; outcome=ringdown. The late-window DNS frequency agrees with the linear eigenvalue omega=8.036574 to about 0.4%, but the decay rate differs from the linear prediction sigma=-0.1127203 and remains under investigation. The DNS steady state differs from the Newton base flow by O(1e-2) in the wake and O(0.2) in the sponge zone.
